title: Data sources
description: Data sources of a project, shared by its screens: one document holds one or more of them (for example all the calls of the orders service). A screen uses one with a reference such as {"ref": "orders/list"} in its dataSources.

datasources.description: Identifier of the document (kebab-case): the first part of the references, orders in orders/list.

description.description: What these data sources are for, for whoever chooses them in the editor.

baseUrl.description: Address put in front of the url of every data source of the document, for example /api/orders or {{ settings.ordersApi }}: the url of each data source is then the rest of the path (/{{ params.id }}). Relative to the same origin, as every url; none if missing.

sources.description: The data sources, by name: the second part of the references, list in orders/list.
